flaws: domain enum is closed; new domains require editing this card (acceptable: a closed enum is the point)
monolingual: schema in JSON only (lifting_plan: emit a Pydantic / dataclass variant once tool_card_codegen lands)
name: redefinition_contract
rationale: Without a contract, redefinition cards would drift in shape and the universal solver / discovery engine could not reliably load them. The contract is the schema half of L34: L34 enforces semantics (a witness exists and works); this card enforces structure (the fields are present and well-typed). Pairing them follows the same separation we already use for theorem_card_contract (structure) + L31 (semantics).
statement: Contract every card under cards/redefinition/ MUST satisfy. Fields: name (snake_case), category (literal 'redefinition'), source_form (sympy-parseable string), target_form (sympy-parseable string), domain (enum), condition (sympy predicate or null), cost_score (integer 1-100), proof_ref (math card name, literal 'axiomatic', or null), witness_kind (enum), examples (non-empty list of {input, source_eval, target_eval} for symbolic/numerical), tags (list of strings). The contract is enforced by L34_redefinition_witness_required.
